intro: Forced Disarmament is an Alliance quest in the Wetlands tasking adventurers with seizing weapon caches from the Dragonmaw clan at Dragonmaw Retreat. By collecting thirty bundles of armaments, players prevent the hostile orcs from equipping additional soldiers for future raids. The confiscated gear is delivered to Captain Stoutfist at Menethil Keep to safeguard the region's vital harbor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Dragonmaw are stockpiling all manner of weaponry. It would be wise to relieve them of these before more soldiers can be armed.
Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep would surely be interested in these.
